Source reconciliation and preservation

Open original catalog page · Repository snapshot used

All seven workbook sheets were inspected, including supporting onboarding, defensive mappings, lookup templates and README. Every original workbook/CSV cell remains available in the embedded source download; extracted workbook cell text can also be viewed below. Cross-source entries were not merged based on title similarity. No site schema, telemetry availability or current MITRE mapping was assumed.

Web content was retrieved from the GitHub source file behind the catalog URL. Technique, strategy (DET), analytic (AN), and data-component (DC) IDs remain distinct. Some source mappings may be conditional, historical or inconsistent; the original qualifiers remain in each record.

References to external rule-artifact paths are preserved, but the referenced files were not supplied. The workbook’s “copy-ready” and CSV’s “Validated” labels are source claims, not validation performed for this consolidation.
